comparison.objective: Sharpen both faces of a kitchen knife on a whetstone and put it down safely.
comparison.physical_skill: Maintain blade contact, angle, direction, and coverage over repeated controlled strokes.
comparison.success_condition: Required strokes and edge coverage on both faces, then safe released placement; versions provide numeric angle, travel, coverage, and dwell criteria.
comparison.reason: Controlled surface stroking and sharpening-angle maintenance do not test perforated-screen flow, bridging, or retention of oversized workpieces.
